system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 2 hours, 12 Spell Uses. Lasts: 24 hours. Gives an inanimate object sapience so it can talk. Roll a -5 Disposition check for how cooperative it is; most things don't like being alive. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
